description:
Upcoming and recent readouts, approvals and trial starts across sponsors, oldest first.

For what comes next, pass from_date as today and pending_only=true, and kind="readout" for trial results;
an event whose outcome is set has already happened.

from_date and to_date take YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM, YYYY-Qn or YYYY. An event is dated as precisely as its sponsor
guided it (a day, a month, a quarter or a year), and it is kept when that period overlaps the window, so an event
guided to 2026-Q4 is still listed from 2026-11-10.

area: "obesity" or "diabetes". kind: "readout" (trial results, including cardiovascular outcomes trials),
"regulatory" (submissions, decisions, coverage and launches), "trial_start" or "company" (earnings, conferences,
investor days). pending_only: only events with no outcome recorded yet.
name: list_catalysts
title: List upcoming catalysts
